assumptions: Criteria remain pending until the lead runs the canonical gate, ./scripts/verify.sh. Neither the full gate, a suite numbered 151 or higher, nor the policy check was run. Suite 156_veldo_0315_reconcile exercises the changed Reconciler.repositories and bootstrap and was not run here. Suite 86_veldo_0127 and all live captures are untouched.

Binding installs at the service's start: bootstrap reads the bound repositories and calls the installer, so a repository gets its hooks at the first start after it is bound. No bind command outside the footprint was changed. The first start of a real service with space management enabled therefore writes into the hooks folder and git configuration of every bound and named plain repository and into settings.json of every named account folder. Nothing on the protect list is touched, and no live repository or account folder was touched by this build.

The engine finds its hook files in hooks/ beside .veldo (or engine/hooks in this repository) and the session script in packs/claude/scripts beside or above the engine. Whether a deployed engine carries both there was not measured. Where it does not, the install record names the refusal and reconcile reports the hooks as missing; nothing is silent.

Chained hooks are shell hooks only (sh, bash, dash, ksh, zsh by their first line). A program, a link, a file with no first line naming a shell and a hook that is not executable are refused and reported, by the owner's rule that an existing hook is kept and chained or refused. An owner's shell hook that the marked line precedes still receives git's input; where neither the hooks folder nor the temporary folder takes the input copy, the owner's lines run and that landing is left to the next reconcile.

The trunk a hook is told (veldo.space.trunk) is the one the work configuration's land entry gives through the spool's about; the fixture has none, so no row sets it. The client was played by running the installed command through sh; no live client was started.
The reports are findings of the reconcile result (hooks_missing and session_hooks_missing), which the service logs; the space.reports API route belongs to a later ticket.
rollback: Revert the two commits. Hooks already installed stay where they are and keep working; a repository bound afterwards gets none. The marked lines and Veldo's own files can be taken out by hand; nothing of the owner's was changed beyond the one marked line.
